bio.text: Steve Berch represents Idaho House District 15, Seat A, and the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory lists Berch as Assistant Minority Leader.

The directory biography says Berch holds a bachelor's degree in marketing from the State University of New York at Albany and an M.B.A. in management information systems from the University of Minnesota.
It says Berch worked for Hewlett Packard in Boise for over 30 years and owns a business-planning consulting firm.
